gloss: first working day of the new year (in offices)

definitions.gloss: first working day of the year; reopening of offices after New Year
definitions.explanation: The day government offices reopen after the New Year holiday, normally January 4. Companies use the word, or {仕事始|しごとはじ}め, for their own first day back at work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{御用始|ごようはじ}めだ。
examples.english: Today is the first working day of the year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市役所|しやくしょ}→市役所：03067_shiyakusho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{御用始|ごようはじ}め⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一月|いちがつ}→一月：00631_ichigatsu⟧⟦{四日|よっか}→四日：02985_yokka⟧です。
examples.english: City hall reopens for the year on January 4.

examples.japanese: {御用始|ごようはじ}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧、⟦{知事|ちじ}→知事：03467_chiji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{職員|しょくいん}→職員：20206_shokuin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新年|しんねん}→新年：09787_shinnen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: On the morning of the first working day of the year, the governor gave a New Year address to the staff.

notes:
The counterpart of ⟦{御用納|ごようおさ}め→御用納め：33909_goyouosame⟧, the last working day of the year (normally December 28). Between the two, government offices are closed from December 29 to January 3.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {御用始|ごようはじ}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧: the first working day of the year
- {御用始|ごようはじ}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{式|しき}: a New Year ceremony at a government office

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{仕事始|しごとはじ}め→仕事始め：32432_shigotohajime⟧: first day of work in the new year — the general word, used for companies and individuals; {御用始|ごようはじ}め is above all the government-office term
